label: Definition
subgoals: Set Av equal to lambda v with v nonzero
Require det(A - lambda I) = 0 for a nontrivial v

label: The characteristic equation
subgoals: Subtract lambda down the diagonal of A
Expand det(A - lambda I) into a polynomial
Solve the polynomial roots for lambda

label: Eigenspaces
subgoals: Plug each lambda back into (A - lambda I)v = 0
Row-reduce to read the free variables
Write the basis vectors spanning the null space
